status: Public documentation derived from accepted frozen evidence; no new experiments

canonical_quality.evidence_class: LOGICAL quality; canonical stored-cache representation and online aging; not physical serving or end-to-end serving quality

niah.inference: Deterministic shared-construction grid; no independent-draw confidence interval

llama_long_context.scorer_note: Primary retains historical article handling; secondary is official LongBench scorer on identical canonical predictions. Legacy in the scorer name does not classify these predictions as legacy.
llama_long_context.confidence_interval_note: 95% paired bootstrap intervals conditional on recorded greedy generations; spanning zero does not establish equivalence

matched_llama_serving.evidence_class: PHYSICAL observed allocator capacity and within-session single-request latency
matched_llama_serving.qualification: A matched, method-native system comparison in ONE H100 session (default V2 runner, eager, single request, 2048-token prompt, 32 output tokens). TurboQuant uses its method-required attention backend (TURBOQUANT + FlashAttention v2 on its four BF16 boundary layers) while BF16 / FP8 / RABIT use TRITON_ATTN; latency differences are therefore system-level, not quantizer-kernel-level. No throughput claim (single request), no quality claim, no generalization beyond this configuration. Exp3 / Exp4 absolute TPOT are not comparable as the same experiment (different snapshot / session).
matched_llama_serving.turboquant_disclosure: TurboQuant was evaluated using our vendored vLLM snapshot (upstream base f329ce4) with the official upstream TurboQuant V2 cache-dtype integration fix from fa4321de3d894c50c5ca0766dffa352d3fb07423 (PR #47609; first released in vLLM v0.25.0) backported. The change only restores the intended cache-dtype dispatch for TurboQuant specs in the model runner's KV-cache reshape; TurboQuant's quantizer, packed cache format, boundary-layer policy, and kernels were unchanged. All four methods ran on the same patched snapshot.
matched_llama_serving.statistics: descriptive only: two fresh-engine legs per condition; no significance tests or CIs
matched_llama_serving.auxiliary_state_note: Allocator capacity is paged pool only; open group and residual are per-sequence state outside the pool. Not total-device-memory compression or a throughput multiplier.

qwen_serving.evidence_class: PHYSICAL serving, distinct from canonical Qwen quality
qwen_serving.qualification: One matched H100 session, eager, single request, 2048 prompt / 32 output tokens; untuned exact fallback paths. Capacity does not establish quality robustness or transfer of optimized Llama kernels.

context.qualification: Maximum tested model-limit point, not a demonstrated maximum feasible context

concurrency.interpretation: Across three independent H100 trials, RABIT-KV sustained the offered 64-request concurrency while BF16 was limited to 47 overlapping in-flight requests, matching its allocator-derived full-length KV ceiling. However, RABIT-KV had lower request throughput than BF16 at every tested offered concurrency, with the gap widening at high concurrency. Thus the physical capacity advantage did not translate into a throughput advantage in the current implementation.

historical_provenance.status: Preserved, never pooled with canonical quality or primary matched latency
historical_provenance.semantic_difference: Legacy V metadata ordering differed and generated tokens did not age. No causal decomposition of their individual effects was run.
historical_provenance.schema_migration: Old final_quality and frozen_deployment keys are superseded; historical contents remain recoverable from the recorded Git blob.

interpretation.headline: Capacity-first system with explicit latency and throughput costs; logical quality robustness is strongly model-dependent.
limitations: One GPU type and one frozen policy; eager-mode comparisons do not establish graph-enabled behavior
Severe Qwen continuation-PPL failure; cause undiagnosed
No canonical Qwen long-context, Qasper, multilingual, or ablation evidence
Logical quality validates representation/aging, not serving execution or later prefill chunks
Saturated retrieval and conditional bootstrap intervals cannot establish general equivalence
CPU and CUDA states are not bit-identical; same-device oracle conformance only
Serialized request/token work and substantial long-context closed-page processing; profiling is diagnostic and perturbs timing
Public adapter preserves frozen gates and external output isolation; offline-tested only. Requires a clean preserved source checkout with matching upstream and the recorded execution environment.

public_reproduction.source_path_policy: Original paths in separate pinned preserved-source Git checkout; public mapped workers are browsing archives
